_doc: Controls, cases and features the static extraction (qa/catalog/tools) cannot see, each with the reason. final_catalog.py merges this file before applying [case:...] tags; an entry the generator starts producing itself is reported under stats.tag_issues.extra_cases_issues so it can be removed here. Cases start not_automated; only a tagged test that acts and asserts makes them automated.
